parts.label: Fundamental-mode model
parts.help: Describe and justify your model for the rope. The numeric check alone does not assess this reasoning.

parts.label: Estimated fundamental frequency
parts.help: Use the physical-pendulum estimate with the supplied length and gravity. Enter Hz. Other justified models require self-review.

parts.label: Frequency ratio f_2/f_1
parts.help: Normalize f_1 to one. Enter f_2/f_1, using the source graph.

parts.label: Frequency ratio f_3/f_1
parts.help: Normalize f_1 to one. Enter f_3/f_1. The tolerance allows graph reading and rounding.
